title: Preserve the artifact reader's UNKNOWN reason in late declared Codex settlement
outcome: A late declared completion with an exact retained binding keeps its existing UNKNOWN verdict and the reason produced by the existing artifact-and-exit judge.
acceptance: For a matched original retained binding, missing or invalid artifacts and an unknown exit preserve the existing judge's UNKNOWN detail on the observation instead of dropping it or retaining stale text.
Behavioral late and carried-completion fixtures assert the row's named reason without changing verdict precedence, original-binding ownership, native verification or wait identity.
